# Pull Request Template

## Description
Brief description of what this PR does.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Code quality / refactoring
- [ ] Test addition / improvement
- [ ] Build / CI improvement
- [ ] Content improvement (explanations, exercises, etc.)
- [ ] New module / sprint content

## Related Issue
Closes #[issue number]

## Sprint / Module Affected
- [ ] java-fundamentals (Sprint 1)
- [ ] oop-fundamentals (Sprint 2)
- [ ] Root project / Build
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD

## Testing
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`mvn test`)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Code compiles without warnings (`mvn compile`)
- [ ] Checkstyle passes (`mvn checkstyle:check`)
- [ ] SpotBugs passes (`mvn spotbugs:check`)
- [ ] PMD passes (`mvn pmd:check`)
- [ ] Javadoc generates without warnings (`mvn javadoc:javadoc`)
- [ ] Full build passes (`mvn clean verify`)

## Documentation
- [ ] README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Module README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] LEARNING_PATH.md updated (if curriculum changed)
- [ ] Code comments / Javadoc added for new public APIs

## Screenshots / Evidence
(If applicable - test output, screenshots of running examples, etc.)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style (Checkstyle)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary (especially complex logic)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG.md with a descriptive entry

## Additional Notes
Any additional information, configuration, or data that might be necessary to reproduce or verify the changes.
